summary: `/start` and `/next` planning-bank routing surfaced a completed hydrated readiness slice for INI-PKB-001 instead of the next personal-control-plane continuation candidate.
evidence: After T-042 completed, INI-PKB-001 readiness still pointed at slice-pkb-001-a, so no claimable backlog item plus stale planning-bank readback made the personal control-plane deployment path appear blocked even though slice-pkb-001-b existed as the next candidate.
recommended_action: When a planning-bank readiness candidate is hydrated or complete, routing surfaces should look ahead to the next ordered candidate and clearly state the approval boundary before hydration, deployment, or personal-root mutation.
